name: Query-conditioned regional memory readout
status: Exploratory PolypGen pilot; freeze before launch
motivation: The prior learned global region-mass bias and pooled region-query adapters did not improve the primary metric. This candidate lets each current spatial query choose among native SDPA reads over predicted foreground, mixed-boundary and background memory keys.
method: At each of SAM2's four memory-attention layers, compute native attention log-mass separately for the stored predicted-mask foreground, mixed-boundary and background keys. A learned per-head linear gate maps each current unrotated projected SAM2 query to three bounded regional log-mass biases. Redistribute regional spatial attention mass by those biases, retaining every key; keep object-pointer attention logits and values in the native path without regional labels. Do not change image encoding, memory writing, decoder or frame schedule.

inspiration_and_code.adaptation: The papers motivate query-dependent foreground/background memory use. The implementation reuses the pinned SAM2 SDPA path and this project's predicted-mask region assignment; the per-query three-region gate is an explicit project adaptation, not a verbatim implementation from those repositories.

model.query_gate: For each layer and attention head, a trainable linear map from normalized pre-RoPE projected query features to three regional log-mass biases.

data.scope: Sequence-disjoint within PolypGen but exploratory only: the full dataset and seq16-23 have already informed previous work; patient-to-sequence independence is unverified.

training.loss: Mean post-prompt decoder mask loss plus object-presence loss over each sampled clip; train the query gates and residual scales only.
training.control: Shuffled permutes the three predicted-region labels within each stored memory frame, preserving per-frame token counts; train with the same clips, schedule and parameterization.

evaluation.primary: Equal-sequence mean present-frame Dice over seq16-23.
evaluation.positive_pilot_criterion: Regional must exceed both native and shuffled mean Dice by at least 0.01, exceed native on at least 6/8 sequences, and add no false alarms. One seed is a screening result only.

decision: Run the real-clip engineering gate first. If it passes, run this frozen sequence-split pilot once. Report a negative result if the fixed criterion is not met; do not tune against seq16-23.
